overview: Six targets offer reusable cache-key construction, memoization wrappers and FIFO ordering. Supplied contexts show extraction requirements; FIFO lacks its base-class context. References document inspected source, not correctness. Listed tests were not run.

reusable_pieces.name: hashkey argument-key builder
reusable_pieces.description: Builds a tuple-based cache key from positional arguments and sorted keyword items, using a sentinel to separate the two.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The supplied file defines supporting _HashedTuple and _kwmark. Preserve both when extracting hashkey. The keyword branch sorts items; the other branch returns _HashedTuple(args). Hashing later memoizes the tuple hash. No explicit argument validation occurs. Retain the supplied copyright and permission notice for copies or substantial portions.
limitations: Arguments and keyword values must support hashing when the resulting key is hashed; this function does not validate them.
Key tests are indexed but their contents are not supplied; no test results establish behavior.

reusable_pieces.name: typedkey type-sensitive key builder
reusable_pieces.description: Extends argument keys with the types of keyword values and positional arguments, enabling type-sensitive memoization keys.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The supplied file defines _HashedTuple, its tuple-preserving addition methods, and _kwmark. Extract these supporting definitions with typedkey. Keyword items are sorted before their types are appended; positional types are appended afterward. There is no explicit validation or recursive type inspection. Preserve the supplied license notice.
limitations: Type tags describe immediate argument values, not nested contents.
Hashability remains a caller assumption. Indexed key tests have no supplied content or execution results.

reusable_pieces.name: methodkey receiver-excluding key adapter
reusable_pieces.description: Delegates method arguments to hashkey while excluding the receiver from the generated cache key.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The supplied same-file context defines hashkey, _HashedTuple and _kwmark; retain that dependency chain. methodkey immediately returns hashkey(*args, **kwargs), with no receiver validation. Decide whether excluding self matches the intended cache-sharing arrangement. Preserve the supplied license notice.
limitations: Different receivers with identical remaining arguments produce equal keys; shared caches require deliberate handling of that behavior.
Indexed method/key test contents are absent. The adapter requires supporting key definitions.

reusable_pieces.name: Locked function memoization helper
reusable_pieces.description: Looks up cached results under a lock, computes misses outside it, and uses setdefault under the lock to prefer an already-stored result.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Supply func, cache, key and a context-manager lock supporting the shown operations. Hits return early. Misses call func outside the lock; insertion ValueError returns the computed value. cache_clear mutates the cache under the lock. Same-file _wrapper selects this helper and applies functools.update_wrapper plus cache metadata; preserve or replace that integration explicitly. Preserve the license notice.
limitations: Concurrent misses can execute func repeatedly; this helper has no pending-key coordination.
Only lookup KeyError and insertion ValueError are handled. Cache, key and lock compatibility is unresolved; no supplied test results validate integration.

reusable_pieces.name: Unlocked memoization with counters
reusable_pieces.description: Caches function results and exposes hit/miss reporting and cache clearing through attributes on the returned wrapper.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: Supply func, cache, key and an info(hits, misses) callback. Hits increment the counter and return early; lookup KeyError increments misses before calling func. Storage ValueError is ignored. cache_clear clears the mapping before resetting counters. Same-file _wrapper selects this helper and supplies functools metadata and cache attributes; extraction must account for that surrounding integration. Preserve the license notice.
limitations: Misses include calls whose function subsequently raises. Counters and cache operations have no synchronization here.
The helper does not validate callback or mapping contracts. No test contents or results are supplied for this target.

reusable_pieces.name: FIFOCache ordering implementation
reusable_pieces.description: Tracks insertion order with OrderedDict and removes the earliest tracked entry. Replacing an existing key moves it to the end.
reusable_pieces.integration_notes: The declaration calls Cache initialization, mutation, clearing and inherited pop, and uses collections.OrderedDict. Base mutation precedes order updates; empty popitem raises KeyError. Supplied FIFO tests assert eviction, size-based rejection and update ordering, but were not run. No same_file_reference is provided: Cache, imports and other enclosing definitions may be absent. Obtain and inspect them before extraction. Preserve the license notice.
limitations: Cache base-class content is absent; validation, size accounting and inherited operations cannot be assessed from these references.
The supplied tests depend on an unsupplied CacheTestMixin. Their assertions are source evidence, not passing results.
